title: Strict henselization as finite local lifts over the henselization
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a commutative local ring with residue field $\kappa$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Let $H=A^{\mathrm h}$ be its henselization, the universal local henselian extension of $A=A_{\mathfrak m}$ [def-weil-pbc-henselization-at-prime], with residue field identified with $\kappa$, and choose a separable closure $\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}$ [def-pd-separable-closure]. For every finite separable subextension $\kappa\subset e\subset\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}$, there is a finite local etale $H$-algebra $B_e$ (finite as an $H$-module and etale in the sense of [def-weil-etale-morphism]), unique up to unique isomorphism respecting an identification $B_e/\mathfrak m_HB_e\simeq e$. Every inclusion $e\subset f$ lifts uniquely to a local $H$-algebra map $B_e\to B_f$ inducing that inclusion on residues. These maps form a filtered diagram. Its colimit $C=\varinjlim_e B_e$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] is a local ring with residue field $\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}$, and there is a canonical $A$-algebra isomorphism, respecting the residue identification, from $C$ to the strict henselization of $A$ at this residue closure, defined by the pointed etale neighbourhood colimit [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] of $\operatorname{Spec}A$, equivalently by the pointed-algebra colimit [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Equivalently this is the strict henselization of $H$ at the same residue closure. Restricting the diagram to finite Galois subextensions $e/\kappa$ gives the same colimit (Galois means separable and normal: all minimal polynomials of elements split in $e$).

proof.text: Apply [lem-wf-henselian-residue-lift-diagram] to $H$ and $K=\kappa^{\mathrm{sep}}$. Its local finite etale lifts, unique residue-compatible arrows and unique isomorphisms give exactly the required filtered diagram. Its Galois cocone-restriction assertion gives the same colimit after restriction, including the structural and residue maps.

proof.text: Apply [lem-wf-finite-local-lift-colimit-structure] to this diagram. It provides a colimit $C$ in $H$-algebras and in rings, with surjection $q:C\to K$, kernel the maximal ideal, local map $H\to C$, henselianity and ind-etaleness over $H$. Thus the residue identification needed for both comparisons is the specified one.

proof.text: Now [lem-wf-henselization-ind-etale-comparison] applies to $A,H,C,q$: it proves ind-etaleness over $A$ and the unique residue-compatible comparisons to the strict-henselization triple colimits over both bases. It identifies these with the pointed-algebra strict henselizations and makes the comparison over $A$ compatible with the canonical $H$-structure.

source.place: Tag 0BSL (remark-construct-sh-from-h), final ind-etaleness and uniqueness sentences; Tags 04GN (lemma-henselization), 0BSI (lemma-composition-colimit-etale), 08HR (lemma-map-into-henselian-colimit), 08HT (lemma-uniqueness-henselian) and 04GW (lemma-strict-henselization-different), applied over both A and its henselization.

proof.text: Finally [lem-wf-geometric-triples-colimit-comparison] applies to this local ind-etale $A$-algebra $C$ and $q$. Choose its allowed algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $K$. The lemma verifies that the relative separable closure is $K$ and that all neighbourhood residue embeddings land there, and gives the canonical pointed-neighbourhood comparison preserving every chart map. Composing the comparisons proves all stated descriptions of $C$ with their residue identifications.
